Rules

Shadowrun Companion options

Books in play decide which gear, spells and adept powers you can pick. The Companion options are off unless your table uses them.

Priorities p. 47

Pick one letter per category. Each letter can be used once; picking a letter that's taken clears it from the other category.

Identity, race and magic

Edges and Flaws SRC p. 35

With the priority system, Edges and Flaws must add up to zero (SRC p. 22). Edges can’t push a rating past the creation limits, target numbers never drop below 2, and Edges and Flaws with the same effect don’t stack. Buying off a Flaw later costs 10 × its value in Good Karma.

Skills p. 45, 66–73

Rating 6 at most at creation. A concentration drops the general skill by 1 and raises the concentration by 1. A specialization drops the general skill by 2, keeps the concentration at the bought rating, and raises the specialization by 2.

SkillBoughtNarrowedConcentrationSpecializationRatings

Languages p. 45, 74

A Street lifestyle also gives a city dialect at half Intelligence. Other languages cost skill points like any skill.

Cyberdeck p. 172–175

Programs

Tick a program to put it on the deck, then pick its rating (size and price shown); tick Loaded for the ones in active memory for the run. Greyed-out ones don’t fit the free storage. Each one is also a line in Gear.

Rigging p. 85, 104, 264

Vehicle stats from the book: core p. 264–265 (cruise/max speed), FoF p. 62–69, or the Rigger 2 list p. 148–166 (one Speed number; Pilot shows Autonav when a vehicle has no Pilot). A red box means that stat isn’t listed here; fill it in from the book.

Weapons and armor p. 88–100, 242

Weapons from your gear, with the dice you roll and range bands (target number: range). Open Add-ons under a gun to fit scopes, smartguns, vents, silencers and so on. Only add-ons that fit that gun are offered (core p. 238–241), and their price is added to the gun in Gear.

Lasting injuries

From a Deadly wound's Body Test (p. 113–114): each lost attribute point also lowers that attribute's racial maximum. Awakened runners who reach Deadly check for Magic loss (p. 115). Karma can buy lost points back (p. 190).

Add or spend nuyen

Log a run payout or a purchase. Nuyen on hand updates, and × undoes an entry.

DateFor¥

Ammo p. 95

Bought ammo is the pool. Loading the gun or filling clips takes rounds from it, and firing uses them up. Raise the ammo quantity in the gear list when you buy more.

Spend Good Karma p. 190

Attributes cost the new rating (double above racial max). Skills cost 2 × new rating, concentrations 1.5 ×, specializations and languages 1 ×. Bought raises update the sheet.

Stash and storage

Gear you aren't carrying. Drag an item to a column, or use its Move menu. Stashed gear stays yours and keeps its price, but it leaves the weapons and armor tables, the ammo tracker and the at-the-table part of the sheet. Vehicles and drones you own show up as places too, so a rigger can park drones in the van.

Save and share

The page keeps your character in this browser only. To keep a copy, move it to another device or share it, use one of these. The files work on their own, with nothing to install and no internet needed.
